prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Input images: the split-flap board and hero are style references only; adapt their disciplined typography, matte mechanics, and live-state rhythm into a real tutoring product, but do not copy their layout, wording, rail branding, or transit content.
Primary request: Render an edge-to-edge first viewport for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, a Vietnamese multi-center tutoring operations platform. The visitor must recognize a live teaching schedule, understand that the system coordinates centers, classes, rooms and attendance, and be able to sign in immediately.
Composition: one large split-flap operations board fills almost the entire screen rather than a generic split hero. The first wide row contains an actual login form with labels “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu”, supporting link “Quên mật khẩu?”, and action “Đăng nhập”. Following rows show exactly: “07:30 · Toán 9A · P.101 · Đang diễn ra”, “09:15 · Văn 8B · P.203 · Sắp bắt đầu”, and “13:30 · Anh 10C · P.102 · Chờ diễn ra”. A compact mark and product name sit at the top with minimal navigation “Tổng quan · Vận hành · Bảo mật” and a small “Hệ thống ổn định” indicator.
Visual direction: dark matte flap modules and brushed-steel framing; bone-white condensed lettering; amber for pending and active emphasis; red only for exceptions. Keep the login controls unmistakably usable and Vietnamese text legible.
Constraints: finished functional website interface, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no train icons, no station names, no transit branding, no generic dashboard card grid, no separate split hero, no photography, no watermark.
